name: wuwa-cutscene-studio
description: Desktop studio for extracting, customizing subtitles, and rendering Wuthering Waves cutscenes.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'cache/temp', '.cache', 'temp'].forEach(p => { try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (_) {} }); try { require('child_process').execSync('cargo clean --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch (_) {} console.log('Build cache cleaned.');"
scripts.clean:all: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'cache', 'export', 'output', 'temp'].forEach(p => { try { fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch (_) {} }); try { require('child_process').execSync('cargo clean --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml', { stdio: 'ignore' }); } catch (_) {} console.log('All artifacts and outputs cleaned.');"
